detail.title: KM500W World of Warships Keyboard & Mouse Combo - Black
detail.overview: The Ant Esports KM500W is a licensed World of Warships edition keyboard and mouse combo with a brushed aluminium-finish top plate and rainbow LED backlighting diffused evenly for comfortable use in dim rooms. Double-shot ABS keycaps sit atop a durable key structure rated for up to 50 million keystrokes, twice the lifespan of a typical wired keyboard, while a dedicated wrist rest adds comfort during long gaming or work sessions. The included 6D mouse offers 4 adjustable DPI levels (800/1600/2400/3200) via an anti-slip rubberized coating and a highly sensitive optical sensor, and slip-resistant keyboard construction guards against accidental spills. Broad compatibility spans Windows 2000 through Windows 10 and Mac OS.
